verdict.rationale: Riskified documents its own Beacon (web and Android) that collects session and device data to feed fraud decisions, and order data sent via /submit or /decide is analyzed. Plaid account data can also be used, and Riskified's analytics team calibrates the models per merchant account. However, nothing shows a developer can supply their own custom fingerprints, behavioral signals or arbitrary metadata fields that change scoring; the device data is collected by Riskified's own tooling, and calibration is done by Riskified staff, not configured by the developer. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata/custom signal fields, a way to bring your own device fingerprints or behavioral data, developer-controlled influence on scoring, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed the model my own signals — device fingerprints, behavioral data, custom metadata — so scoring reflects my business, not just network defaults
